verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's DuckLake lets you build a lakehouse on your own files in your own cloud object storage (e.g. an S3 DATA_PATH), so data can stay in storage you control, which eases leaving. However, no evidence documents an explicit export path (e.g. COPY to Parquet/CSV), a full-account export, or names the open file formats used. Missing for 10: documented export of all databases to named open formats (Parquet/CSV), an exit/migration guide for non-DuckLake managed storage, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a complete export.
